subject: Mid-contract add-on request + pro-rated credit for unused committed capacity
messages:
From: Rebecca Lin <rebecca@linnahealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: mid-contract add-on & pro-rated credit for committed capacity

Hi Karthik,

Hope you’re well — quick ask from our finance and platform teams. We’ve seen a material increase in usage this month and need to add a 200k token committed band to our existing plan effective immediately. Our current commitment period runs through 2027-03-31.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood add the 200k add-on mid-cycle and provide a pro-rated credit for the unused portion of our existing commitment for Q1? Our CFO expects the credit to show in December billing.
- If possible, we’d like to lock any pricing adjustments now so this doesn’t impact renewal budgeting.

I attached a short usage export for the last 90 days to help with calculations. Happy to hop on a quick call this week to walk through numbers.

Thanks,
Rebecca
Director of Infrastructure
Linna Health

Attachments:
- usage_report_Q4_Linna_2026.csv (CSV; 45 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Rebecca Lin <rebecca@linnahealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: mid-contract add-on & pro-rated credit for committed capacity

Rebecca — thanks for the note and the attachment. We can support a mid-cycle add-on; I’ve looped in Neha (rev ops) and Markus (legal/commercial) to surface the options and get you a clean amendment.

High level — we usually do one of the following for mid-contract additions:
- pro-rated credit for unused committed spend, applied to the next invoice, or
- an accelerated discount on the new add-on if the customer signs an amendment within a short window.

I’ll let Neha propose concrete options and numbers back to you by EOD tomorrow. Would you be able to confirm the target effective date (Dec 20 vs Jan 1)? That affects the pro-rate math.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 10:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: mid-contract add-on & pro-rated credit for committed capacity (internal)

Internal note — ran the numbers against the usage file. Three practical options to present to Linna:

Option A (standard): Full pro-rated credit for remaining committed dollars through 2027-03-31. Credit applies to next invoice. New 200k add-on at current committed unit price.
- Pros: clean accounting for customer, minimal legal changes.
- Cons: revenue delta for this quarter.

Option B (preferred — time-bound): 75% of the unused committed dollars credited if customer signs amendment and accepts a 12% effective uplift on the new add-on band. Credit posts in Dec invoice if docs signed by 2026-12-28.
- Pros: preserves some near-term economics, incentivizes quick sign.
- Cons: slightly higher sticker for the customer on the add-on.

Option C (conservative): No credit. Offer a 6% discount on the new add-on band and extend current pricing guarantees to the amended term.
- Pros: protects quarterly revenue.
- Cons: less customer-friendly.

I drafted a short amendment (linna_amendment_draft_v1.pdf) with Option B populated — includes credit calc, effective date block, and a clause to co-term the add-on to existing contract end (2027-03-31).

Recommend pushing Option B as the primary path; give customer 10 business days to accept. If they push back, fallback to Option A.

Neha
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachments (internal):
- linna_amendment_draft_v1.pdf (PDF; draft)

Hi Rebecca — thanks for the patience. Based on our review we can offer the following (preferred path highlighted):

Option B — Preferred (time-bound):
- Add-on: 200,000 token committed band, starts on signature date.
- Price: 12% uplift on Linna’s current committed unit price for the new band.
- Credit: 75% of the unused value of your current commitment (calculated pro-rata through 2027-03-31). Credit posts to the Dec invoice if amendment signed by 2026-12-28.

I attached the draft amendment with the credit calculation populated and a redline that co-terms the add-on to your existing contract end date. If this looks good, sign via DocuSign and the credit will be applied automatically. DocuSign link below.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/modify/abcd-efgh-2026
Attachment: linna_amendment_draft_v1.pdf

If you prefer we can also do Option A (full pro-rate credit + same unit price) or Option C (no credit + 6% discount). We’re recommending B to balance your budget needs and our runway for Q4.

Would you like me to schedule a 20-minute call to walk through the amendment?

Thanks,
Karthik
